result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The `cli` module compiles. I did not run any tests or try either command, so the help output and the report generation are unchecked.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is also listed in the no-argument usage overview, using the landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatch in `run` accepts either name and calls the existing `updateLandscape` method. In that method, `-help` prints the usage of whichever name was typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section. It describes `analyzeLandscape` as the documented name and `updateLandscape` as the previous name that still works.
